thread:
maria k: taking primary for the night until 07:00 UTC. quick heads-up: noticed intermittent P99 tail spikes after the 23:12 deploy. monitoring now, dropping a short playbook and who covers what if it pages.

incident-bot: Pager: P2 inference-tail-latency eu-central-1 — alerted 4 on-call. Incident page: https://redwood.internal/incidents/4762001111

devops-bot: Deploy finished 2026-03-14T23:12Z -> inference-runtime:v2.8.0 canary @25%. No immediate canary failures.

sam t: i'm secondary until 03:00 UTC. if this goes P1 i'll take bridge and run the escalation checklist.

lee: I'm available for node scaling or redis ops. runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/kv-cache-stall

maria k: triage plan (short): 1) confirm customer impact via synthetics + 5xx rates 2) check HPA/queue depth and pod restarts 3) inspect KV prefix TTLs and cold-cache effects 4) if persistent, reduce canary / fallback to stable variant or rollback. quick commands below.

jordan: quick checks i run:
```
# tail metrics
curl -s "https://telemetry.redwood.internal/api/metrics?series=tail_99&region=eu-central-1" | jq .
# pod health
kubectl -n inference get pods -o wide | grep inference-runtime
# autoscaler
kubectl -n inference get hpa inference-runtime -o yaml
```

maria k: customer-impact so far: synthetic probes show ~0.6% of requests >700ms, no uptick in 5xx. spike began ~23:15 UTC and affects a small subset of routes.

alex r: low-risk mitigations to try first: rotate a few KV shards or reduce canary throughput so fewer new pods pull cold KV. examples: 
```
# scale down canary replicas
kubectl -n inference scale deploy/inference-runtime --replicas=3
# adjust routing weight
curl -X POST https://gateway.redwood.internal/route -d '{"service":"inference","variant":"v2.7.4","weight":80}'
```

sam t: P1 escalation checklist (short): 1) open bridge + set context 2) set pager to all-hands 3) run autoscaler diagnostics: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/autoscaler-diagnostics 4) trigger fallback routing to stable variant.

ops-runbooks: pinned refs for tonight: KV cache: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/kv-cache-stall ; Autoscaler: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/autoscaler-diagnostics ; Rollback: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/rollback-guide

incident-bot: Update: 5 alerts in the last 10m — still P2. Assigned: @maria k, @sam t, @lee

maria k: i'm running a perf dump and will paste logs shortly. if you're unreachable call me at +1-555-0133. note: if we delete keys, stagger deletes to avoid thundering herd.

jordan: recommended flush pattern: delete ~10-15% of shards at a time with a 20s pause between rounds. use SCAN based deletes, not KEYS, in prod.

lee: autoscaler nudge tips -> check controller logs, metrics-server, and the HPA status. steps in the autoscaler runbook.

maria k: 23:38 UTC update: lowered canary to 10% and scaled +2 pods; tail spikes dropped back to baseline. keeping primary watch until 07:00 UTC. handing off to morning primary at 07:00. leaving this thread as a short night playbook.

sam t: thanks — i'll remain on backup until 03:00 UTC then handoff notes saved.

maria k: closing loop: no customer-impact escalation required. if it recurs, run `incident-bot escalate` and open bridge. :white_check_mark:
